$comment: MCP tools of every Bipe MCP surface, one data class each (bipe ADR 0130, ADR 0210; bipe-chat/bipe#436). surface: bridge (bipe-business, the company's server), public (bipe-api, mcp.bipe.chat, Sao Paulo), personal (bipe-mcp on the user's machine). class: public (anyone can see it on bipe.chat, no opt-in), metadata (lists, assignees, tags, status, times; no text), content (message text, notes, attachments; off by default, opt-in per scope with the destination named). writes: none, draft (puts a draft in the user's apps, bipe#866), send (sends a message), state (changes status, tags or room state). A personal tool with writes send needs scope content-send, and bipe-mcp sends only while the user's switch is on: global account data personalSend.accountDataType {"enabled": true}, set from Settings on the phone, off by default (ADR 0210 as corrected by MZ on 30 October 2026). Every message it sends carries personalSend.markerField {"client": <MCP client name>}, and Bipe apps label it. A public tool has class public, writes none and no scope. The servers read this file; docs and the site render it. No second list. readerMarker: the room state event (state key = the member's own user ID) that bipe-mcp sets before it returns other members' messages (set_full_content); every member's app shows that the member's assistant reads the chat (assistantReaders, test-vectors/assistant-send.json).

tools.name: resolve_handle
tools.en: Find the public Bipe account behind an @handle.
tools.pt: Acha a conta pública do Bipe por trás de um @.

tools.name: get_public_profile
tools.en: Read the public profile of an @handle, as bipe.chat shows it.
tools.pt: Lê o perfil público de um @, como o bipe.chat mostra.

tools.name: check_cnpj_seal
tools.en: Check whether an @handle has a verified company seal (CNPJ).
tools.pt: Confere se um @ tem o selo de empresa verificada (CNPJ).

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.en: List customer conversations with status, assignee, tags and times. No text.
tools.pt: Lista as conversas com clientes: status, responsável, etiquetas e horários. Sem texto.

tools.name: read_conversation
tools.en: Read the messages of one customer conversation.
tools.pt: Lê as mensagens de uma conversa com cliente.

tools.name: send_message
tools.en: Send a message to a customer as the company. The customer sees that a program answers.
tools.pt: Manda uma mensagem ao cliente em nome da empresa. O cliente vê que um programa responde.

tools.name: send_question
tools.en: Send a question card with answer buttons to a customer.
tools.pt: Manda ao cliente uma pergunta com botões de resposta.

tools.name: assign
tools.en: Assign a conversation to a person on the team.
tools.pt: Passa uma conversa para uma pessoa da equipe.

tools.name: set_status
tools.en: Set the status of a conversation: open, waiting or done.
tools.pt: Muda o status de uma conversa: aberta, aguardando ou resolvida.

tools.name: tag
tools.en: Add or remove a tag on a conversation.
tools.pt: Põe ou tira uma etiqueta de uma conversa.

tools.name: add_note
tools.en: Add an internal note to a conversation. The customer never sees it.
tools.pt: Põe uma nota interna na conversa. O cliente nunca vê.

tools.name: list_chats
tools.en: List your chats with names, unread counts and times. No text.
tools.pt: Lista suas conversas com nomes, não lidas e horários. Sem texto.

tools.name: read_my_messages
tools.en: Read the messages you sent in a chat, and your notes. Never other people's messages.
tools.pt: Lê as mensagens que você mandou numa conversa e suas notas. Nunca as dos outros.

tools.name: read_chat
tools.en: Read every message of a chat. Works only after set_full_content; every member then sees that your assistant reads.
tools.pt: Lê todas as mensagens de uma conversa. Só funciona depois de set_full_content; aí todo mundo da conversa vê que seu assistente lê.

tools.name: draft_message
tools.en: Put a draft in a chat on your phone. Nothing is sent until you tap send.
tools.pt: Deixa um rascunho numa conversa no seu celular. Nada sai até você tocar em enviar.

tools.name: send_message
tools.en: Send a message as you. Works only while 'Assistant can send' is on in Bipe Settings; the chat shows it came from your assistant.
tools.pt: Manda uma mensagem como você. Só funciona com 'Assistente pode enviar' ligado nas Configurações do Bipe; a conversa mostra que veio do seu assistente.

tools.name: set_full_content
tools.en: Turn full reading of one chat on or off. On shows every member a notice.
tools.pt: Liga ou desliga a leitura completa de uma conversa. Ligada, todo mundo da conversa vê um aviso.
